hanover.definition: n. the English royal house that reigned from 1714 to 1901 (from George I to Victoria)
hanover.translation: n. 汉诺威市（位于德国）

hanoverian.definition:
n. any of the British rulers who were members of the House of Hanover
n. a member (or supporter) of the house of Hanover
a. of or relating to the former English royal House of Hanover or their supporters
hanoverian.translation:
n. 汉诺威
a. 汉诺威的
